warnings: Intervals are copied from the frozen 5000-replicate question-cluster bootstrap, descriptive and unadjusted.
Session ranges are ranges of three means, not confidence intervals.
Same 60 questions/task recur across three sessions; no new holdout, no pooling of sessions or hardware regimes.
Human semantic annotation remains incomplete; structural and lexical diagnostics are not human judgments.
A passing analysis_status.json alone is not a full-experiment completion receipt. Counts are bound to the independent archive/grid/receipt review.

Contract absolute counts use the local v8.1 prefix-replay parser. The received v8 parser accepts indentation before ####; one equal-outcome question increases both strategy counts by one under three contracts. All paired differences and the 114 strict-discordance cases are unaffected.
